answer: An agent enters the haven only after posting a 400-unit escrow bond, its referrer named on a public referral graph. The bond locks 20 epochs; any peer may dispute a fake, and if upheld, both bond and referrer stake are slashed. Forging 1,000 identities costs 400,000 units, draining the tide of cheap fakes before flooding honest work. An honest agent pays 400 once, keeps its bond and earns undiluted rewards, like a lotus above muddy water.
